analysis: Matched UWB-only versus frozen corrected fusion, and correction scope diagnostics
calibration: Reuse only Oct17 P1 per-link offsets frozen in merged PR31; no refitting
primary_comparison: U: independently solve antenna XY at every original B keyframe from the same four corrected range-bin medians, fixed height 0.20m, same range sigma 0.20m and same pseudo-Huber residual transform. F: PR31 D batch graph unchanged. A: PR31 aligned Odom unchanged.
U_initialization: Three fixed room-frame seeds [2.665,2.69], [0,0], [5.33,5.38]. No Odom, endpoint, previous solution, or temporal prior; choose lowest objective among successful solves.
evaluation: Keep original final stop+[2,7) windows and componentwise median XY; manual references enter evaluation only. No continuous trajectory truth.
static_windows: initial [first output, first forward start-0.5); idle1 [first forward stop+2, turn_start); idle2 [turn_stop+2, second forward start); endpoint original evaluation window. Commands/Odom/IMU are stationarity diagnostics, not independent truth.
orientation_diagnostic: Across idle1/idle2 around the in-place turn, compare measured range changes with candidate-start-aligned Odom antenna geometric range changes. Approximate transform and unmeasured intermediate point mean residual changes are not independently verified orientation bias.
dropout: One prespecified full-wall range outage per run: [second_forward_start+5, second_forward_start+10). Remove every wall factor whose original keyframe center falls in this interval, retain Odom and all other settings. Diagnostic of batch interpolation, not online behavior or accuracy truth.
position_scope: Summarize all previously reported independent-reference link residuals after P1 correction. The same (2,3) point has two recordings; link cases are correlated and do not provide independent statistical replicates.
not_allowed: fit correction or alignment to endpoints
interpret smoothness or fit residual as accuracy
use Oct11 old installation with Oct17 calibration
claim batch dropout interpolation as online recovery
